The '''Archenar asteroid field''' was an asteroid field<ref name="TOR" /> located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the Archenar asteroid field was the theater of a [[Battle of the Archenar asteroid field|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR" />
